jobs.title: Microsoft/Azure Stack Engineer Consultant
jobs.description:
Sia is a next-generation, global management consulting group. Founded in 1999, we were born digital. Today our strategy and management capabilities are augmented by data science, enhanced by creativity and driven by responsibility. We’re optimists for change and we help clients initiate, navigate and benefit from transformation. We believe optimism is a force multiplier, helping clients to mitigate downside and maximize opportunity. 

With expertise across a broad range of sectors and services, our 3,000 consultants serve clients worldwide from 48 locations in 19 countries. Our expertise delivers results. Our optimism transforms outcomes.

Job Description

The role

We are looking for a Microsoft/Azure Stack Engineer to join our Data Science & AI team as a consultant. This is a client-facing role first: most of your time is spent on client engagements, designing and building Azure infrastructure and platform solutions, advising on cloud strategy, and representing Sia's technical delivery capability directly to the client. Alongside that, you will get hands-on with AI on the side of the business: building demos and proofs of concept on Azure AI Foundry that support new client opportunities, rather than running or maintaining an internal platform. If you want client exposure plus a genuine way to build AI skills on top of your infrastructure expertise, this is a team where that combination is real.

What you will do

Work directly with client teams and stakeholders as a consultant, explaining technical trade-offs and architecture decisions in plain language.
Design and implement Azure infrastructure, including networking, compute, storage, and identity components (Azure AD/Entra ID, VNets, App Services, AKS).
Build and maintain CI/CD pipelines using Azure DevOps or GitHub Actions to support infrastructure-as-code deployments (Terraform, Bicep, or ARM templates).
Manage and optimize Microsoft 365 and Azure governance, including security baselines, cost management, and compliance controls.
Build demos and proofs of concept on Azure AI Foundry to support business development and potential client work.
Troubleshoot and resolve infrastructure issues across hybrid and cloud-native environments.
Advise clients on cloud migration strategy, landing zone design, and the Azure Well-Architected Framework.
Collaborate with client IT teams, architects, and Sia consultants to deliver technical roadmaps and implementation plans.
Document architecture decisions, runbooks, and operational procedures.
Depending on seniority, mentor junior engineers and contribute to internal capability building within the Azure and AI practice.

Qualifications

What you bring

Comfortable working directly with clients as a consultant, and able to explain technical trade-offs in plain language.
Willing and able to travel for client work (mostly within the Benelux).
3+ years of hands-on experience with Microsoft Azure in a production environment.
Strong knowledge of Azure core services: compute, networking, storage, identity, and security.
Experience with infrastructure-as-code tools (Terraform, Bicep, or ARM templates).
Familiarity with Azure DevOps, GitHub Actions, or comparable CI/CD tooling.
Working knowledge of Microsoft 365 administration and Entra ID/Azure AD.
Scripting proficiency in PowerShell, Python, or similar.
Interest in or experience with Azure AI Foundry or building AI demos/proofs of concept is a strong plus.
A relevant Microsoft certification (AZ-104, AZ-305, or AZ-400) is a plus.
Fluent in Dutch and English.
For senior candidates: experience leading architecture decisions on client-facing engagements and mentoring other engineers.

What do we offer?

Competitive salary package, including annual salary increase, bonuses, and NS Business Card.
Tailored training and development opportunities to position you as an expert in your field.
Flexible working arrangements (office, home, client sites) and international project exposure.
Collaborative global environment fostering professional growth and knowledge sharing.

Additional Information

Unfortunately, we are unable to provide a work permit for this position.

jobs.title: Network Automation Engineer
AI Developer (Azure)
jobs.description:
About the Company

Our client is a fast-growing Microsoft Data & AI scale-up that has recently secured a strong new round of funding to accelerate its growth.
The company helps organisations adopt, design, and deploy responsible and practical AI solutions. With teams based in Amsterdam and Dubai, they work across the Microsoft AI ecosystem to deliver Copilot adoption programmes, sector-specific IP, custom AI solutions, governance frameworks, and advanced training.
A hybrid working model offers flexibility, including the opportunity to collaborate in the Amsterdam office twice per week.

The Role

We are looking for an Azure AI Developer
to join the Pro Code Development Stream.
In this role, you will design and build advanced AI agents, cloud-native services, retrieval pipelines, vector-based search systems, and custom copilots using Azure AI Foundry, Azure OpenAI, and modern engineering frameworks.
You will contribute to both internal accelerators and customer-facing solutions, working closely with low-code specialists and Azure engineers to create secure, scalable, and high-performing architectures.

Key Responsibilities

Design and develop AI-driven applications using Azure AI services
Build advanced AI agents and custom copilots
Develop retrieval pipelines and vector-based search systems
Architect cloud-native microservices solutions
Contribute to reusable internal accelerators
Collaborate with cross-functional teams to deliver secure and scalable AI platforms
Ensure best practices in API design, CI/CD, and cloud engineering

What You Bring

Strong hands-on experience with Azure AI services (including Azure OpenAI)
Experience building cloud-native applications in Azure
Proficiency in Python, TypeScript, or C#
Solid understanding of:
Microservices architecture
RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation) patterns
API design
CI/CD pipelines
Passion for AI engineering and continuous learning
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills

What’s Offered

Very competitive salary
Hybrid working model (2 days per week in Amsterdam office)
Work at the forefront of Microsoft AI innovation
A stable, well-funded scale-up environment with strong growth ambitions
International collaboration opportunities
Exposure to cutting-edge AI projects
An ambitious and engineering-driven culture

jobs.title: Drupal developer
jobs.description:
Organisatie

Deze organisatie is de afgelopen jaren uitgegroeid van een specialistische kennispartner tot een snelgroeiende internationale tech-platform. Waar men ooit startte binnen een nichemarkt, wordt er nu hard gewerkt aan een breder aanbod dat diverse opleiders, trainingen en sectoren met elkaar verbindt.

De IT-afdeling speelt hierin een cruciale rol. Van het ontwikkelen van digitale leeromgevingen en webshops tot het beheren van complexe API-koppelingen en event-driven datawarehouses. Het team bestaat uit 8 developers die nauw samenwerken binnen een platte organisatie, waar korte lijnen, pragmatisme en een nuchtere mentaliteit die standaard zijn.

Functie

Het team waarin jij terechtkomt, is verantwoordelijk voor de volledige digitale beleving binnen de online verkoopkanalen en voor de doorontwikkeling van een platform dat dagelijks door duizenden gebruikers wordt bezocht. De focus ligt op gebruiksvriendelijkheid, performance en een consistente klantervaring. Binnen het team komen meerdere expertises samen, variërend van back-end development tot moderne front-end technieken, contentmanagement en datagedreven optimalisatie.

Het team ontwikkelt en onderhoudt high-traffic websites en digitale touchpoints. Daarbij spelen UX, toegankelijkheid, betrouwbaarheid en schaalbaarheid een centrale rol. Het werkgebied omvat onder andere:

Back-end development en API-ontwikkeling
Front-end engineering met moderne frameworks (o.a. React)
Contentmanagement en platformbeheer (Drupal)
Marketing analytics, SEO/SEA/GEO en CRO
Implementatie van webstandaarden zoals WCAG
Continu verbeteren van performance, security en gebruikersflows

Functie-eisen

Aantoonbare werkervaring als Drupal developer
Je bent communicatief vaardig en hebt een sterk analytisch vermogen
Teamplayer met oog voor kwaliteit

Aanbod

Salaris tot €6.500,- bruto per maand o.b.v. 40 uur
Werkweek van 32 tot 40 uur
8% vakantiegeld en 20 vakantiedagen (met de mogelijkheid om extra dagen bij te kopen)
Hybride (2 dagen per week op locatie)
Reiskostenvergoeding
Laptop en thuiswerkbudget
Trainingsbudget voor persoonlijke en professionele ontwikkeling
Informele werksfeer, platte organisatie en veel eigen verantwoordelijkheid

jobs.title: Backend Developer
jobs.description:
In a technically exciting and dynamic environment, you significantly contribute to the successful development and operation of our brand-new Secure Access Service Edge (SASE) offerings. You will develop backend software, reduce toil and develop automation to manage our environments at scale.

What impact will you have?

Together, we evolve our SASE offerings using novel security architectures. We drive the technical transformation enabling a redefinition of the connectivity offerings. To do so, you are passionate and keep yourself deeply informed with the evolutions in Network, Cloud, Endpoint Security, and IT. You also enjoy working across multiple disciplines such as design, development, integration, testing, and operations.

Innovation, design, development, integration, test and operation (DevOps) of our brand-new Secure Access Service Edge (SASE) products.
Software deployment in the Cloud.
Definition of Security Policy policies for various Operating Systems and provision of these policies providing the best User Experience.
Definition, designing, building, and managing of of Security reports and management dashboards for internal and external stakeholders.
Troubleshooting and debugging in all environments.
SRE, continuous improvement and automation of workflows and processes to reduce toil

Must-haves

Master’s or Bachelor’s degree (Uni/UAS) in computer science.
4+ years of experience in backend
Experience in NoSQL databases
Knowledge of CI/CD and DevOps technologies
Experience with cloud development (AWS and Kubernetes).
Curiosity and passion to constantly learn new technologies.
Enthusiasm for agile working methods and principles.
Learn and share/teach know-how.
Very open-minded as well as solution- and team-oriented.
As a constructive challenger of our way of thinking and working.
Excellent oral and written communication skills in English.
Nice to have: Experience working with Java & Spring Framework

Want to know more about us?

We are serving the Swiss market as Switzerland’s leading IT & Telecom company. Thus, we are actively driving digitalization and networking, and tapping new paths for our customers and our employees. Our values are spark passion, aim high and stand true.

Since 2019, we have been building up the coolest DevOps Center with a wonderful office at the World Trade Center in the heart of Rotterdam. We are currently recruiting IT passionate professionals who are keen on developing high-quality software, have an agile mindset and appreciate the collaboration with motivated colleagues from all over the world.

What's in it for you?

Work environment

Agile way of working, multi-cultural work environment promoting work-life balance
Autonomy, flexibility, opportunity and growth
Cool office space in the World Trade Center Rotterdam!
Are you coming to the office by bike or car? You can park right here at the office
Be a part of our events to build a stronger Swisscom community - for example, culture lunches, fun quizzes, game nights and a lot more!

Allowances

Full relocation support (Housing, settling in, etc.) for you and your family
200 euros per month Telephone/internet allowance
275 euros per month contribution to health insurance
5 Paid training days and access to Swisscom learning platforms
Travel allowance reimbursement
500 euros home office allowance
Gym subscription, Tax advice, and language course
Salary range: 60,000 to 70,000 euros gross per year including holiday allowance

Leaves policy

Work from abroad possibility for one month per year
Care, bereavement, maternity and paternity leaves
25 days paid vacation days plus Dutch national holidays

Contract terms

To begin with you will receive a fixed term contract (one year), after 6 months of your employment with us, after a feedback meeting with the team, there is a possibility of extending the contract
The salary ranges mentioned in our Job Descriptions are base annual gross salaries including the 8% holiday allowance
